title: Settings
entryHint: Calaos server options and the configuration backup.
backupHint: The configuration files of the box, in one zip.
backupWarning: The file contains passwords in clear text: the sign-in, the cameras, the MCP token. It lands unencrypted in your downloads; keep it somewhere safe. The backup also lets anyone delete your calaos.fr address.
hint: The box's own options: notifications, history, InfluxDB, touch screens.
loadFailed: The settings could not be read.
restartHint: One of the saved settings is only read when Calaos server starts.
restarting: Calaos server is restarting. The page reconnects by itself.
secretHint: The current value is never shown. Leave the field empty and save to remove it.
unrestorableIntro: The backup was saved, but the box would refuse to restore these files as they are:
unrestorableSafety: The safety copy was saved, but the box would refuse to restore these files from it:

unrestorableCause.not_loaded: the server did not load it at startup (corrupted or unreadable); the backup holds its bytes as they are
unrestorableCause.missing: it is missing on the box
unrestorableCause.unreadable: it could not be read on the box
unrestorableCause.empty: it is empty on the box
unrestorableCause.refused: its content fails the checks of a restore (too large, not valid XML, wrong root or newer format)
unrestorableCause.unknown: the box reports a problem with it

restoreHint: A backup zip, its JSON file, or io.xml and rules.xml. Nothing changes before you confirm.
restoreCompare: What the backup holds next to what this box holds now
restoreKept: The current configuration is kept on the box first.
restoreDownloadFailed: The current configuration could not be downloaded, so nothing was restored. {reason}
restoreRestarting: Calaos server is restarting with the restored configuration. The page reconnects by itself.
restoreSlow: The box is taking longer than expected. This page reconnects by itself when it comes back.
restoreDone: Configuration restored. The previous one is kept on the box (backups/{folder}).
restorePartialWaiting: The restore failed half way and the box is restarting: its files may be a mix. The previous configuration is kept on the box (backups/{folder}). The page reconnects by itself.
restorePartial: The restore failed half way: the box's files may be a mix. The previous configuration is kept on the box (backups/{folder}).
restoreUnconfirmed: The box is back, but its answer was lost in the restart. Check that the configuration is the one you restored.

restoreWarning.household_login_changes: The household sign-in changes: phones and the touchscreen will need the household password of the backup, and so will this page.
restoreWarning.mcp_token_changes: The MCP token changes: assistants connected to this box will need the token of the backup.
restoreWarning.ddns_changes: The calaos.fr address settings change to those of the backup.
restoreWarning.invalid_options: Some settings of the backup would be refused by this box. Check them after the restart.
restoreWarning.no_local_config: The backup has no box settings: the box keeps its own.
restoreWarning.devices_removed: Devices of this box are not in the backup: they will be removed.

restoreError.too_big: This file is over 8 MiB, too big to be a Calaos backup.
restoreError.too_many_entries: This zip holds too many files to be a Calaos backup.
restoreError.encrypted: This zip is encrypted. Unzip it, then pick io.xml and rules.xml.
restoreError.duplicate: This zip holds the same file twice, so it cannot tell which one to restore.
restoreError.two_folders: This zip holds two project folders. Unzip it, then pick the io.xml and rules.xml of one of them.
restoreError.compression: This zip uses a compression method the browser cannot read. Unzip it, then pick io.xml and rules.xml.
restoreError.entry_too_big: One file of this zip is over 2 MiB once unpacked, more than the box accepts.
restoreError.not_a_zip: This file is not a zip archive.
restoreError.corrupt: This file is damaged and cannot be read.
restoreError.missing_files: io.xml and rules.xml are both needed to restore.
restoreError.bad_json: This JSON file cannot be read.
restoreError.bad_format: This JSON file is not a Calaos backup.
restoreError.mixed: Pick one zip, one JSON file, or the XML files, not a mix of them.
restoreError.not_utf8: A file of this backup is not valid UTF-8 text.
restoreError.no_inflate: This browser cannot unpack zip files. Unzip it, then pick io.xml and rules.xml.
restoreError.message_too_big: This configuration is too big to be sent to the box at once.
